programme.desc: This light-hearted 'a-go-go' romance depicts how three doctors pursue three beauties who play hard to get!

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: A man on the run (Fu Sheng) learns that heroism is likely to lead to nihilistic desecration.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: Controversial director Chu Yuan combines stars to create a masterpiece about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women expect of it.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: In this award-winning Chang Cheh film, David Chiang plays a psychotic who stops at nothing to avenge his elder brother's death.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: When a detective's bullet changes direction in mid-air to zero in on its target, a terrifying supernatural connection comes to light.

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po and Chang Yi play a noble swordsman and a one-armed swordswoman who find themselves up against the evil Crimson Charm gang of thieves and thugs.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: A follow-up to the previous blockbuster, this 60's musical features an unemployed magician whose love life is as twisted as his tricks.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: A detective's son's attempt to punish a swindler leads to him and his father having their own face-off. Starring Jimmy Wang Yu.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: Loyal to the emperor, the protagonist attempts to stop the delivery of a message depicted across twelve gold medallions that is to be delivered by traitors.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: Hsu Hsia, a great kung fu actor himself, both directs and leads a team of four martial arts choreographers in his hilarious tale of 'kung fu pickpockets.'

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: When villains 'Winged Tiger' Teng Fei and 'Underworld King' Yin Te Lung unite, the martial arts world is plunged into chaos. Can this deadly duo be stopped?

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu Lan
programme.desc: A young woman joins the army in place of her old, ailing father and only when she returns home is the truth revealed.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: A man devotes his life to mastering the sword in order to exact revenge on the three men who killed his family and abducted his sister.

programme.title: Song of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei exchanges her martial arts weaponry for a syringe in this exotic contemporary drama by Pan Lei.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Legendary director Chang Cheh teams Alexander Fu Sheng and 'Venoms' Lo Meng and Kuo Chue in an exciting tale of a kung fu blacksmith.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: From veteran director Li Han-hsiang comes this fascinating period drama, starring Li Kun as the ingenious Lord Liu, who is much envied by the Emperor.

programme.title: Man of Iron
programme.desc: In this fight-filled sequel, Chen Kuan-tai's character wins a bet against a gang leader's son. Soon, father and son are hot on his heels!

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: A singer struggles against the odds to keep her career and marriage intact. Starring Jenny Hu, Peter Chen Ho.

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: Ultimate combat is in the offing after King Eagle Chan Fei learns that Hung Ching Tien murdered their chief in a power struggle.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Be tickled by the slippery efforts of three pickpockets, so adept at their chosen skill that they even manage to fleece three beauties of their underwear!

programme.title: The Protectors

programme.title: The Proud Twins

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: This tragic tale depicts the life of Fang Pi Yu, a singer whose husband dies in his attempt to free her from her past, and whose father-in-law throws her out.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: In this martial arts epic, a gruesome family feud ensues due to a prince being favoured more than his brothers. Starring David Chiang.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: A woman gets involved in a Ching Dynasty salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and dilemmas gone rotten.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor

programme.title: Sweet and Wild

programme.title: The Water Margin

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade

programme.title: Unique Eats
programme.desc: From a chef making Italian pasta with Mexican flavors to a groundbreaking functional cocktail bar to a couple that roasts whole goats behind a tire shop, Stephanie Izard finds unique eateries serving up one-of-a-kind food.

programme.title: Family Style
programme.desc: From brothers selling mom’s Syrian food to a Filipino family remixing a classic dessert to a mom and son running an Indian restaurant out of their house, Stephanie meets multi-gen families turning family recipes into smash hit food business.

programme.title: Home Cooking
programme.desc: From a homerun Greek dinner party series to a backyard that’s become a gourmet deli to a Burmese pop up running out of an apartment kitchen, Stephanie Izard meets cooks finding ingenious ways to serve mouth-watering food out of their houses.

programme.title: Citrus Sunshine
programme.desc: Winter citrus is here to brighten up your day. Frankie is fixing up some light, zesty, and affordable recipes to add a little seasonal sunshine to your plate.

programme.title: A Leftover Glowup
programme.desc: Give last week’s leftovers the makeover they deserve with Frankie’s recipes for tasty, waste-reducing meals that transform uninspiring excess food into fresh and exciting dishes. Your bank account will thank you.

programme.title: Romantic Steakhouse Dinner
programme.desc: Give your wallet a break by taking the fine-dining experience straight to the comfort of your home. From tender, juicy steak paired with classic sides, to decadent desserts, Frankie’s got your date night meal covered.

programme.title: Fancy Pants Pasta
programme.desc: This week, treat yourself to a restaurant-worthy pasta dinner at a fraction of the price, as Frankie cooks up some of his signature dishes featuring show stopping sauces.

programme.title: The Big Game
programme.desc: Brackets are complete and all that’s missing is food to fuel your team’s run. Huddle around the kitchen as Frankie preps the ultimate watch party spread. These savory, spicy and sweet dishes are championship-worthy even if your bracket goes bust.

programme.title: Bananas For Bananas
programme.desc: As one of the cheapest members of the produce aisle, bananas will save you bunches of money when you whip up these delightfully appealing recipes that go above and beyond a basic bread.

programme.title: Piece Of The Pie
programme.desc: There may be infinite ways to define pie, but the only math that matters is what makes these sweet and savory dishes fit the bill. In true Struggle Style, Frankie rolls out his best tips and tricks for enjoying hassle free, cost friendly pies.

programme.title: Suppertime Superstar
programme.desc: Whether you’re cooking for a casual weeknight or a special occasion, Frankie shared delicious and hearty dishes that will not only shine on the dinner table, but they’ll also impress your guests, without costing an arm and a leg.

programme.title: I Need To Eat Right Now
programme.desc: At the end of a long, hectic day, when you need dinner in a pinch, Frankie unlocks his not-so-secret formula for whipping up quick and easy meals, using minimal ingredients that will satisfy your cravings and feed the family in a flash.

programme.title: Cry Me An Allium River
programme.desc: Frankie takes on his longtime frenemy, the onion, and all its powerful relatives. There might be a few tears shed along the way, but they are well worth the delicious and flavorful results, from sweet buttery leeks to the ultimate onion masterpiece.

programme.title: Meals Under $7
programme.desc: At a loss when your pantry is empty? With these recipes, you can walk into any grocery store with only $7 and walk out with everything you need for an entire meal. Because yes, you can whip up a nutritious meal at an affordable price!

programme.desc: Mia Starr gives a crash course in her all-time favorite, most used decorating techniques. From piping styles to watercolor frosting to maximalist designs, she teaches the basics of holiday cake decorating, in her own signature style.

programme.title: Fantastic Pastry Presents
programme.desc: Tis the season for gift giving! Mia walks us through her favorite pastry presents to give to loved ones. From classic cookie gift tins to no bake cheesecakes to savory bakes of cheese and crackers. There is something here for everyone on your list.

programme.title: Bakes On A Budget
programme.desc: Money can be tight around the holidays. From the $3 cookies you will have to try to believe, to a show-stopping $25 trifle, Mia has got you covered - just because you’re on a budget doesn’t mean you have to skimp on style or taste!

programme.title: Bakes Around The World
programme.desc: Join Mia on a trip around the world – without leaving the kitchen! From the Japanese Christmas Cake to Jewish Rugelach to German Pfeffernüsse to Mexican Buñuelos. Your taste buds will get a tour with these holiday bakes from around the world.

programme.title: Grubby Good Food
programme.desc: Send your taste buds on a first class food tour without even leaving the Struggle kitchen! Frankie whips up his favorite regional specialties from five destinations, making them as authentic as possible while sticking to his budget.

programme.title: Frankie’s Italian Faves
programme.desc: Everyone knows Frankie can’t live without pasta, but this week he shares his favorite Italian recipes that don’t require any kneading. Add these simple, delicious dishes to your weeknight menu to complete your Italian dish repertoire.

programme.title: Happy Halloween
programme.desc: Boo! It’s spooky season, and what better way to get into the spirit than with affordable, party-friendly Halloween dishes that scream trick or treat?! But be warned, these meals are scary good.

programme.title: Oktoberfest
programme.desc: Join Frankie as he shares his budget friendly takes on Oktoberfest-inspired dishes, perfect for celebrating the fall season with friends. These festive and hearty meals will keep you cozy and full, and best of all, pair nicely with a beer.

programme.title: A Thanksgiving Harvest
programme.desc: Time to dig in to the one holiday of the year that is all about the food! Think outside the pumpkin pie crust for these four unique offerings. Mia’s got you covered with the bread, two show-stopping desserts, and a creative way to use your leftovers!

programme.title: Holiday Cookies
programme.desc: Cookies are the number one baked item during the holidays. Mia shows us how to make some new and inspiring recipes; from buttercream stickers to zebra shortbread leading to a final bake that will make any cookie lover do a double take!

programme.title: Gingerbread Spectacular!
programme.desc: It’s time to celebrate all things gingerbread! This classic holiday flavor gets an update from Mia. From the not-so-basic cake, to the most delectable cookie, and finally the ultimate gingerbread house; Mia will show why this is a holiday staple.

programme.title: Holiday Party Treats
programme.desc: Host the ultimate holiday party with these sweet and savory recipes for a crowd! Create a spread for all to enjoy. Mia will whip up wintery bark, bake a savory holiday wreath, and design a cupcake tree complete with sugared and piped ornaments.

programme.title: Weeknight Noodles
programme.desc: Chef Noah Galuten cooks up a collection of easy and satisfying pasta dishes quick enough for weeknights. Don't Panic!

programme.title: Grilling and Smoking
programme.desc: Chef Noah Galuten grills up a perfect yet simple burger topped with cheddar, lettuce, onion and his 'special sauce'. Don't Panic!

programme.title: Christmas Special
programme.desc: Chef Noah Galuten celebrates Christmas with his twist on the traditional "Feast of the Seven Fishes" including ceviche, crudo, oysters and more! Don't Panic!

programme.title: Grandmas Pizza
programme.desc: Chef Noah Galuten cooks classic Grandma style pizza including homemade dough, sauce and more. Don't Panic!

programme.title: A Journey to Salad Town
programme.desc: Salads can be way more fun! Come to Salad Town, for Mustard-Shallot Vinaigrette; Probiotic Ranch with Cheddar Croutons; a no-measure salad when for when you’re in a rush; and the crunchy, crispy, acidic, cheesy, Chopped Salad of your dreams.

programme.title: Rustic Comfort Pastas
programme.desc: Perfect Pantry Puttanesca is packed with more flavor than you could ever hope for; a Rustic Pork Ragu will make you wonder why anyone ever makes Bolognese: and a Vegetarian Mushroom Ragu will make you wonder why anyone ever eats meat.

programme.title: How have you bean?
programme.desc: Beans are one of the best foods in the world. They are sustainable to grow, great for your nutrition, affordable and delicious. So in this episode, we're taking a deep dive into beans!

programme.title: The Sandwich Episode
programme.desc: This is.... THE SANDWICH EPISODE, featuring "The Bear" culinary producer Courtney Storer. Courtney and Noah recreate the iconic steak sandwich from the beloved tv series.

programme.title: The Soup Episode
programme.desc: It’s time to get warm and fire up some soup. Pantry Minestrone makes a veggie-loaded comfort soup using almost entirely canned or frozen pantry ingredients. We’re also going to show you how to make a beautiful homemade chicken stock.

programme.title: Thanksgiving Special
programme.desc: Noah walks us through making his Smoked Turkey Gravy recipe. Get a jump start on Thanksgiving and make your stock in advance! Saving yourself the headache the day of.

programme.title: Perfectly Prepared Steaks
programme.desc: Big Daddy Dale Talde shows you how to marinate, prep, & grill up the biggest and best steaks out there. From a Hanger Steak with Salsa Verde to a Ribeye with Ginger Chili Relish, and tops it all off with the father of all steaks… The Porterhouse.

programme.title: New Orleans-Style Shrimp & Oysters
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings us to the bayou as he creates a NOLA-inspired menu complete with Chargrilled Oysters, Black Pepper Shrimp Po’boys, finishes it off with Bananas Foster, and washes it all down with a Fruity Grilled Hurricane.

programme.title: Beer Brats & BBQ Ribs
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde grills up summer favorites perfect for any backyard BBQ. Cheddar beer brats in a pretzel bun, BBQ lamb ribs with Chinese mustard sauce, watermelon lime soju punch, & warm donuts with grilled strawberries & whipped cream for dessert.

programme.title: Sausage Egg & Cheese All Day Long
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings out the best of brunch with sweet and savory hits such as Bacon Wrapped Dates Stuffed with Chorizo, Maple Sausage, Egg, & Cheese Fried Rice, and the tastiest BBQ Duck, Egg, & Corn Scallion Pancake Sandwiches you’ve ever eaten.

programme.title: Pizza Party on the Grill
programme.desc: It’s Pizza Time! Chef Dale Talde grills up amazing pizzas for every palate including a Detroit Style Pie, a Cheddar Naan Pie with a Spiced Chick Peas & Potatoes, and gives your childhood favorite French Bread Pizza a much needed upgrade.

programme.title: Apocalypse Burgers
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde kicks the summer off right with a burger blowout featuring Brisket Burgers with Grilled Onions and Blue Cheese, Shrimp Burgers with XO Sauce and a Fried Egg, and Lamb Sliders with Feta Ranch and don’t forget the Lemon Oregano Fries.

programme.title: Summer Surf 'n' Turf
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde kicks lobster & steak to the curb as he puts a Spanish-style spin on your typical surf ‘n’ turf by creating Pork & Clams, Lobster and Mushroom Fideos, and Tomato & Tuna Bread then washing it all down with a tasty Michelada.

programme.title: Bougie Badass Burgers
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings your basic burgers to a new level with his dry-aged beef burger with potatoes and truffle dijon mayo, a part-beef part-pork belly burger with cheddar & an egg, and lastly a crispy mushroom tortilla burger with salsa & cheese.

programme.title: Grill These Sandwiches
programme.desc: Mad Good Food Host Derrell Smith joins Chef Dale Talde at the grill as they cook up some stupendous sandwiches including a Salmon Pastrami Reuben, a Meatball Banh Mi, and even some Grilled Ice Cream Sandwiches.

programme.title: Luxe Lobster & Prime Rib
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde pulls out all the stops for this daddy-sized dinner. He grills up prime rib with herb & horseradish crust, lobster & chili sauce American, charred green beans with garlic tahini, and cheddar-stuffed parker house rolls.

programme.title: The Future is Flavor
programme.desc: Frankie harnesses the power of time to transform simple ingredients into flavorful goods that’ll stick around for a long time. Learn the basics of preserving, pickling & curing to make dinner anything but a struggle. It just takes a little patience.

programme.title: Pantry Pasta
programme.desc: Keep your pantry stocked with a few basic staples, and you’ll always have ingredients on hand for dinner, especially for pasta night. In this episode, Frankie creates delicious pasta dishes with the kitchen’s best-kept secret weapon – the pantry.

programme.title: Potato Variety Show
programme.desc: Today, Frankie’s slicing, mashing and smashing his way through the spud species, an essential staple for any Struggle kitchen. They’ve got so many talents and textures that whichever way you dig ‘em, potatoes will never let you down.

programme.title: Suppertime Superstar
programme.desc: Whether you’re cooking for a casual weeknight or a special occasion, Frankie shared delicious and hearty dishes that will not only shine on the dinner table, but they’ll also impress your guests, without costing an arm and a leg.

programme.title: I Need To Eat Right Now
programme.desc: At the end of a long, hectic day, when you need dinner in a pinch, Frankie unlocks his not-so-secret formula for whipping up quick and easy meals, using minimal ingredients that will satisfy your cravings and feed the family in a flash.

programme.title: Piece Of The Pie
programme.desc: There may be infinite ways to define pie, but the only math that matters is what makes these sweet and savory dishes fit the bill. In true Struggle Style, Frankie rolls out his best tips and tricks for enjoying hassle free, cost friendly pies.

programme.title: Cry Me An Allium River
programme.desc: Frankie takes on his longtime frenemy, the onion, and all its powerful relatives. There might be a few tears shed along the way, but they are well worth the delicious and flavorful results, from sweet buttery leeks to the ultimate onion masterpiece.

programme.title: Eggscellent Techniques
programme.desc: In this special technique episode, Frankie teaches us several methods for cooking a quintessential ingredient: eggs. The scramble, the omelet, the Benedict – learn to make them just the way you like them.

programme.title: Cabbage, cabbage, cabbage
programme.desc: Cabbage has long been an underrated green on the field, and it’s about time Frankie gives it a starring role. This leafy head proves itself as the versatile ingredient we need it to be, affordable year around, delicious and filling.

programme.title: 5-Ingredient Recipes
programme.desc: Who said struggle meals can’t be delicious? Don’t sleep on these 5-ingredient recipes – simple weeknight meals that are anything but boring, and with a few pantry staples, you’ll have dinner on the table in no time.

programme.title: Game Day
programme.desc: Frankie throws a game day party for under $25. He makes three no-fuss appetizers that are cheaper, healthier, and tastier than subpar game day take out. So gather around with friends and cheer on your favorite teams. Or just eat. Both are a win.

programme.title: Winter is Here
programme.desc: It’s the dead of winter in Frankie’s kitchen, which means it’s that time for hearty, delicious, and warming homemade meals. So you’re saving more money, while you’re staying in, already saving money. It’s a winter miracle.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang Ep10
programme.desc: Rohana desak Fariz agar berkahwin dengan Rania. Bagaimanapun Fariz menolaknya dan bertegas walau apa cara sekalipun, dia akan tetap berkahwin dengan Ainnura. programme.title: Cubit - Cubit Cinta

As long as they live, Jamal belongs to them.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt gets up close and personal with Albert, Flamingoland's 12-foot alligator, as he moves to a new home. Teddy the pet sheep has suspected calcium deficiency and needs emergency treatment, and Marcel the marmoset leads Matt a merry dance around the surgery. Back at Flamingoland, a reluctant macaw needs his beak trimming -V and Matt comes face-to-face with the new pride of lions.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In a very special festive edition of The Dog Rescuers, Inspector Lyndsey Taylor is called to a case of a desperate dog, left home alone at Christmas. With concern growing for the dog's health, can Lyndsey secure a warrant for police to enter the property in time?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet clean to bring you the most entertaining puppy clips out there: overexcited pups, pilfering pups, pups who fall asleep in their dinner bowls, puppy vloggers, driving pups, and even a look at the latest craze: pups who go into a quivering frenzy at the sight of-K doorstoppers.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The charm of cute rabbits is irresistible! An old man raised hundreds of rabbits?! Playful little rabbits are spoiled yet timid! Crazy about rabbits! Caregivers takes care of the little rabbits "wholeheartedly"?!

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've got stupid vs intelligent dogs, talented dogs, sporty dogs, pug life, dogs getting stuck, sleepy dogs, and dogs acting like humans.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Alan Davies returns for a brand-new series of The Dog Rescuers and it's going to be bigger and better than ever. programme.title: Best Of Pets

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Fishes swim in the water. What a healing thing it would be to be able to look at the blue ocean every day if we can own an underwater world at home! How can one be the creator of the underwater world? Moreover, in this small ecosystem, most players are male and they even jokingly describe each other as "going underwater"; "Cute Pet Guide" takes you to appreciate the mystery of "going underwater"!

programme.desc: In Dagenham a terrified Jack Russell called Phoebe is found abandoned in a travellers' site full of rubbish. Surrounded by danger and left with a badly broken leg she must undergo a three hour operation but will she ever be able to walk again?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide

With fierce aquatic creatures appear randomly?! Cute looking frogs that bring good luck?! Biology class: Witness how tadpoles turn into frogs?! programme.title: Hunting Games
programme.desc: Two dangerous armed men must hunt each other and fight to death over millions of dollars in cash in this high octane wilderness survival story.

programme.title: Project Legion
programme.desc: A young man trapped in his apartment with a swarm of demons outside his door must find a way to survive the night and escape from apartment 213.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - Serena's Game
programme.desc: Refusing to comply with Tommy’s demands, Max and Paul conspire to have the British gangster eliminated and Serena arrested. With Tommy dead and Serena in handcuffs, it appears as though Max has succeeded. His plan goes awry, however, when MI6 force Max to help Serena bring down her employers: the Russian mob. Torn between a life of crime with Serena or happiness with Ava, nothing is ever simple in the life of Max Mayfair.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page, a brilliant mother-daughter swindler team, target the city's wealthiest men. Max marries them and then sues for alimony after she catches them involved in an affair with Page.

programme.title: Override
programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Hayes Hodges, an attorney, takes up the offer of defending his friend Colonel Terry Childers, accused of ordering his squad to open fire on a group of demonstrators.

programme.title: Clean
programme.desc: Tormented by his criminal past, Clean attempts a quiet life caring for his community and as a mentor to his young neighbor Dianda. When local gang violence puts his neighbor’s life in danger, Clean finds himself returning to his violent past.

programme.title: Locked In
programme.desc: A single mother must protect her daughter and herself during a heist gone wrong at a high-tech storage facility.

programme.title: Mayfair - Shooting Paul
programme.desc: Hoping to put the past behind him and go legit, Max is persuaded by Paul to open a new Mister Mayfair club in Portugal. Conflict, however, seems to follow Max wherever he goes. Drawn into a violent turf war between London Gangsters and the Italian Mafia, his relationship with Ava is jeopardised by the arrival of his former flame, Serena. Max’s carefully crafted world seems to be collapsing around him. With his family’s lives on the line, Max is blackmailed by British crime boss, Tommy, to assassinate his best friend, Paul.

programme.title: Crom
programme.desc: High school teenagers accidentally unleash an ancient Irish entity on their hometown and must stop it before midnight on Halloween.

programme.title: Rat Race
programme.desc: A Las Vegas casino magnate, determined to find a new avenue for wagering, sets up a race for money.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - A Song To Kill For
programme.desc: Max Mayfair has it all; a beautiful girlfriend, Ava, a new London crime family, and thanks to his latest heist, a priceless diamond necklace. However, when mafioso Calbone’s henchmen catch up with Mike and Armen, determined to drag them back to New York to pay for their crimes, Max has everything to lose. Teaming up with his old friend, Marseille Mafia crime boss, Paul, Max hatches a plan to lure the New York Mafia to Mayfair.

programme.title: Mojave Diamonds
programme.desc: A former MMA fighter and his brothers must rescue their kidnapped family from a dangerous crime syndicate after $50M of illegal diamonds gets stolen.

programme.title: Broadcast
programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: During WWII, the American army have raced their way through the countryside on the border of France entering Nazi Germany. Hitler has deployed his secret weapon. Lieutenant Frank Ross encounters the Nazi weapon and an intense aerial battle ensues.

programme.title: Mister Mayfair - The Spyce Of Life
programme.desc: Returning from a romantic getaway with Ava, Max finds himself on the wrong side of the law yet again. Now blackmailed by MI6, Max must spy on two suspected terrorists; Aziz and Omar, who are regular customers at his club. Accompanied by his London crime family, Max breaks into Omar’s country estate and discovers his sinister plan. With everything on the line, Max must race to uncover a highly skilled hacker’s identity before it’s too late.

programme.title: Broken Star
programme.desc: Abandoned by her friends and family and with her career in jeopardy, starlet Markey Marlowe is sequestered in a duplex with a reclusive landlord who just may be more dangerous than she is.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Any Bullet Will Do
programme.desc: Two Brothers find themselves on opposing sides of the fight as one hopes to help abolish slavery while the other believes it is his God-given right.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: Based on the true story, Edgar Valdez, drug lord and cartel leader, is betrayed by one of the brothers. Seeking retribution, Valdez will risk it all to gain control of the Feliz cartel.

programme.title: Centigrade
programme.desc: A married couple find themselves trapped in their frozen vehicle after a blizzard and struggle to survive amid plunging temperatures and unforeseen obstacles.

programme.title: Johnny & Clyde
programme.desc: Johnny and Clyde are two serial killers who are on an endless crime spree. They decide to assemble a group of criminals and misfits to steal from Alana's casino and pull off the heist of the century.

programme.title: High Voltage
programme.desc: After a lightning strike kills the lead singer of a band, she is resurrected with electrifying special abilities.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Hideout
programme.desc: Evading police at a remote farmhouse after fumbling a robbery, four criminals discover that the family living there is not who they appear to be.

programme.title: The Legion
programme.desc: Noreno, a half-Roman, is entrusted with the mission of crossing the snowy mountains of Armenia, swarming with Parthian patrols, to seek help for his slowly dying men.

programme.title: Blood Of Redemption
programme.desc: When the most powerful criminal empire in the land comes crumbling down from within, it is up to a former henchman to put the puzzle pieces together in order to find those responsible and extract revenge.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Hunting Games
programme.desc: Two dangerous armed men must hunt each other and fight to death over millions of dollars in cash in this high octane wilderness survival story.

programme.title: Altitude
programme.desc: A female FBI agent is offered millions to help a thief escape from a hijacked airplane.

programme.title: Override
programme.desc: In 2040, a female humanoid A.I. is hacked by her husband and forced to kidnap the U.S. vice president's son and execute him on live television.

programme.title: Operation Sea Wolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Come Out Fighting
programme.desc: During WWII, the American army have raced their way through the countryside on the border of France entering Nazi Germany. Hitler has deployed his secret weapon. Lieutenant Frank Ross encounters the Nazi weapon and an intense aerial battle ensues.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page, a brilliant mother-daughter swindler team, target the city's wealthiest men. Max marries them and then sues for alimony after she catches them involved in an affair with Page.

programme.title: Broadcast
programme.desc: After a billionaire creates a drug called INOC which stops the aging process, the future of a world where death no longer exists is seen. The story of the fate of mankind is told while also revealing an elusive truth to its unknowing spectator.

programme.desc: A Las Vegas casino magnate, determined to find a new avenue for wagering, sets up a race for money.

programme.title: The Commando
programme.desc: A DEA agent returns home with PTSD after a botched mission and must now protect his family from a home invasion when a recently freed convict and his henchmen come after their stash of millions hidden inside of the agent's home.

programme.title: Crom
programme.desc: High school teenagers accidentally unleash an ancient Irish entity on their hometown and must stop it before midnight on Halloween.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep5
programme.desc: Ep05 Kegembiraan Roz dapat menyelamatkan Rin terbantut apabila penculik Rin telah melepaskan diri daripada tahanan polis. Roz juga mengaitkan kes penculikan Rin dengan kes Dr Kaos Jr yang terlepas dari penjara dengan rancangan jahat yang lebih besar.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep6
programme.desc: Ep06 Roz dan Rin diserang. Dia menjejak para penyerangnya ke pangkalan rahsia mereka. Ejen Mah dihantar untuk menyiasat tetapi dia ditangkap. Roz, Datin Seri dan Rin bekerjasama membebaskan Ejen Mah dan Roz dapat mengalahkan Nora, ketua penculik. Tetapi Dr Kaos Jr telah maju selangkah dan bereksperimen dengan senjata barunya.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep7
programme.desc: Ep07 Daniel marah kerana pembanteras jenayah melalkukan kerja polis dengan menangkap penjenayah-penjenayah. Tanpa dia ketahui itu adalah kerja ibunya sendiri. Sementara itu, Roz ditangkap oleh Dr Kaos Jr. Datin Seri menyelamatkan Roz dan mereka dapat maklumat nama ketua penjahat yang merancang semua kejahatan ini.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep8
programme.desc: Ep08 Daniel menyesaki ibunya menyembunyikan sesuatu. Roz pula menyelinap masuk pengkalan operasi Gagak Putih dan telah diserang. Roz berdepan dengan kesilapan masa silamnya sebagai seorang ibu, isteri dan ejen perisik, yang kini kembali untuk memusnahkan keluarganya.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep6

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep1

It’s disaster, Code Yellow, as the "storm on steroids" is only just beginning to rend the earth.

After discussing the list of suspects with Sikorski, he asks his physician friend Dan to test the blood on the bullet found in the briefcase. He asks his buddy Tim Sanders, publisher of the local paper, to have his staff examine the crime scene photo for signs of tampering and to check the paper’s files for information on Roy Bremmer. He asks his brother-in-law Brad, a professor of material sciences, to examine the mysterious briefcase.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E06 - Church on the Mountain
programme.desc: In the Yukon, decisions can change everything in a heartbeat, especially in such a tough landscape. The brothers are closing in on the enormous mountain grizzly, now just 500 yards away, and it's up to Chris to make the call.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E07 - Valley of Snow

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E01 - Lost!
programme.desc: Nick and Laura subject themselves to intense survival training with the Survival Training School of California deep in the mountains.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E02 - Sniper Science
programme.desc: Nick and Laura explore the variety of skills that military snipers use: marksmanship, long range shooting, detection, stalking, camouflage, infiltration, special reconnaissance and target acquisition.

programme.title: Survival Science - - S01:E03 - Surviving a Bear Attack
programme.desc: Nick and Laura test the power and speed of grizzly bears using Hollywood stunt tools to experience an attack. Also: an attempt to recreate an arrow shot that saved a man from a bear attack.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E04 - Surviving a Mountain Lion Attack
programme.desc: Laura and Nick break down the behaviors, strength, eyesight and speed of mountain lions through experiments and explore techniques to deal with these apex predators.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E05 - Surviving a Lightning Strike
programme.desc: Laura and Nick determine the power lightning has and how it behaves at a state-of-the-art Direct Effects Lightning Test Lab. They provide advice for hunters and fishermen to protect themselves from it.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S01:E09 - Leming Bear Attack
programme.desc: The harrowing tale of a father's desperate attempt to save his son's life from a grizzly bear attack while out hunting together.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S01:E10 - Season Recap
programme.desc: We take a look back at the season's survival stories with a more in-depth look from former Army Special Forces soldier, Terry Schappert.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E01 - After the Fall
